items.requirement: An authorized opaque principal can list all currently visible soft-holds (same visibility universe as get-by-id). Success is a full dump with no paging; each item includes LookupResponse-equivalent fields (holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt, availableStock). Empty collection when none are visible. No stock or hold mutation on any path.
items.rationale: List correctness and a checkable success shape (including empty) are the core delta; callers and contract tests need machine-checkable read semantics without inventing filters or paging.
items.threshold: Authorized list always returns the full currently visible set with LookupResponse-equivalent items including availableStock; empty collection when none visible; never mutates stock or holds.
items.measurement: OCL-derived Vitest contract tests plus OpenAPI success-schema exercises for full-dump list (including empty) and non-mutation.

items.requirement: Only an authorized opaque principal may list soft-holds (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ: opaque allow/deny only; not full IAM). Unauthorized callers fail with named UnauthorizedError; stock and holds are unchanged.
items.rationale: Extends the canonical opaque-principal AuthZ Means to the additive list operation; user keeps the same Means as reserve/release/lookup.
items.threshold: Unauthorized list always fails with UnauthorizedError and never mutates stock or holds; authorized opaque principal receives the shared visibility universe.
items.measurement: Contract tests and OpenAPI UnauthorizedError channel; OCL preconditions on list; cite POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ.
